Tree of Life: Binah (Understanding)
blends.desc:
Join us on a journey through the Tree of Life where we mix technology with art and learning!

The Final Blend is hosted on WAXDAO: https://waxdao.io/blends/1827

Each week, a [Sephirah](https://nfthive.io/collection/jumbiewaxart?tab=drops) will be released that will be used to craft the next branch in the Tree of Life along with the knowledge that is held within it. 

Each [Upgrade](https://neftyblocks.com/c/jumbiewaxart/blends) will grow the Tree's strength and ability to generate RGBits / HR 

When the Tree of Life reaches it's maximum size, it will bear the fruit of knowledge in the form of a Growth Pack. 

### Upgrading to the Spectral Tree of Life: After week 9

Each Sephirah of a Full Grown Tree of Life can be [Activated](https://nfthive.io/crafts?collection=jumbiewaxart) with RGBits to generate a small amount of [GROTON](https://wax.alcor.exchange/swap?input=WAX-eosio.token&output=GROTON-jumbiedao.gm) per Hour while also increasing [RGBits](https://wax.alcor.exchange/swap?input=WAX-eosio.token&output=RGBITS-jumbiedao.gm) per Hour

### Tree of Life Irrigation System:
The Tree of Life WAX Farm is part of the [Jumbie Art Sharing Contract](https://waxblock.io/account/jumbie.bag?code=jumbie.bag&scope=jumbie.bag&table=config2&lower_bound=&upper_bound=&limit=10#contract-tables) which will add a % of WAX generated by the entire Jumbie Art NFT Ecosystem.  The Pool will grow for 9 weeks before the first Growth Packs start to be minted, which have a 50% chance of Spawning a Seed of Life NFT that will allow access to the pools WAX Rewards.

More info being added as it's developed.


[Discord](https://discord.gg/35YCzUw)
[Jumbie Art on X](https://x.com/jumbieart)
[PFP RGBitSlots Drop](https://nfthive.io/drop/nfthivedrops/5199)
